newsitem.title: USA: Exxon wins Lubrizol U.K. patent lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Exxon wins Lubrizol U.K. patent lawsuit.

text.p: Exxon Corp said on Wednesday the English High Court of Justice declared invalid a Lubrizol Corp patent that was the basis of a Lubrizol lawsuit against Exxon.
Lubrizol alleged that certain Exxon motor oils and motor oil additives infringed upon the patent, Exxon said.
Also, the court found that Exxon's products would not have infringed upon Lubrizol's patent, if it were deemed a valid patent, Exxon said.
Exxon is entitled to recover its reasonable legal costs from Lubrizol, it said.
An Exxon spokeswoman was unable to determine the legal costs from the Lubrizol Corp case.
Lubrizol later said it plans to appeal the ruling regarding the patent for motor oil additives.

The company has similar lawsuits against Exxon in other parts of the world, where the outcome of cases in other parts of the world, including the United States, where the patent was found to be valid, Lubrizol said.
Canada and France are among other nations that have legal action pending about this matter, Lubrizol said.
